title: Comanche - Cavalry Family Housing
address: 18010 T.J. Mills Blvd Ste B209, Fort Cavazos, TX 76544
description:
Comanche I is a dedicated military housing community offering comfortable two-bedroom, one-bath homes located right on Fort Cavazos. Ideal for active-duty service members and their families, this small, quiet neighborhood provides the convenience of on-post living with easy access to major roads like Clear Creek and Tank Destroyer. Its single-story layout and recent upgrades to windows, doors, and exterior siding ensure both comfort and modern appeal.

These homes come fully equipped with all major appliances, washer/dryer connections, central air conditioning, and newly installed privacy fencing. All utilities are included, giving military families one less thing to worry about when budgeting. Mature trees provide shade throughout the community, and added touches like a little free library help foster a friendly, close-knit atmosphere.

Residents enjoy close proximity to key Fort Cavazos amenities including the PX, Commissary, Furniture Store, golf course, and recreation centers. With walking trails, basketball and tennis courts, and multiple playgrounds nearby, Comanche I offers the perfect mix of convenience and quality of life for those who serve.

address: 2254 Brian Mcelroy Dr, San Antonio, TX 78236

description:
Airman Scott Village 1193 is a spacious two-bedroom, one-bath home located within the secure, gated community of Lackland Family Homes on Lackland Air Force Base in San Antonio. This residence offers military families the comfort and convenience of living on base with the added benefits of a walkable neighborhood and a strong sense of community. It’s an ideal housing option for active-duty service members stationed at Lackland AFB.

The 1,193 sq. ft. floor plan features updated finishes, a fully equipped kitchen, and garage access—perfect for families who need functional space and modern features. Designed with military life in mind, this home includes curbside trash service, lawn care, and on-site maintenance to take the stress out of home upkeep. Pet-friendly policies and lighted walking trails make this a great place for the whole family, pets included.

Residents enjoy access to a wide range of community amenities, including pools, playgrounds, picnic areas, basketball and tennis courts, a sand volleyball court, and a community center that regularly hosts resident events. With all of Lackland AFB’s facilities nearby, including schools, commissary, and medical services, Airman Scott Village 1193 offers everything a military household needs in one connected and supportive environment.

title: Heritage Heights - Cavalry Family Housing
address: 18010 T.J. Mills Blvd Ste B209, Fort Hood, TX 76544
description:
Heritage Heights is one of the newest on-post neighborhoods at Fort Hood (known as Fort Cavazos from 2023 to 2025), built for junior enlisted Soldiers and their families. The neighborhood replaces the 1960s-era Chaffee Village, which began coming down in 2021, and is managed by Cavalry Family Housing, the Army’s privatized housing partner on post.

Homes are single-family three-bedroom, two-bath designs with open floor plans, gathering spaces, and two-car garages. They are Energy Star certified and built to LEED design standards, so they run efficiently and stay comfortable through Central Texas summers. Hundreds of homes were completed in 2024, and more are planned through 2027.

Outside your door you will find walking paths, community gardens, a dog park, and a playground. Cavalry Family Housing operates 11 neighborhoods on post, so contact the leasing office or visit their website for current availability, eligibility, and floor plan details.

title: Watkins Terrace - Fort Sam Houston Family Housing
description:
Watkins Terrace is a family housing neighborhood at JBSA-Fort Sam Houston in San Antonio, managed by Hunt Military Communities. The neighborhood offers single-story and two-story three- and four-bedroom homes, with three-bedroom plans of about 1,200 square feet and four-bedroom plans of about 1,380 square feet.

Homes feature central air conditioning, washer and dryer hookups, and attached garages. Watkins Terrace is close to the on-post child development center, the elementary and high schools, and the MWR sports field, which makes daily routines easy for families with children. Pets are welcome, with breed and size restrictions.

Residents have access to Fort Sam Houston’s community amenities, including three community pools, 16 playgrounds, basketball and tennis courts, walking trails, a self-help store, and 24-hour emergency maintenance. Active-duty families pay rent in arrears with no up-front rent or security deposit. Contact the housing office for current availability and rank eligibility.

title: Randolph Family Housing - JBSA-Randolph
address: 205 New B St E, Universal City, TX 78148
description:
Randolph Family Housing offers historic homes inside the gates of JBSA-Randolph, the famous “Showplace of the Air Force” in Universal City, just northeast of San Antonio. Managed by Hunt Military Communities, the neighborhood is known for its stucco exteriors, original hardwood floors, and Spanish Colonial Revival character, with homes renovated since 2007.

Most homes have four bedrooms, and some plans have five. The operator lists dozens of floor plans, such as a four-bedroom, three-bath layout of about 2,187 square feet. Features vary by home and include central air, Energy Star appliances, decorative fireplaces, patios, private backyards in select homes, and carport-style carriage houses.

The gated, walkable community includes a pool, fitness center, community center, parks, and playgrounds, and trash, recycling, and bulk pickup are included. Housing is open to active duty across enlisted and officer ranks, and may also be available to retirees, DoD civilians, and Guard and Reserve members. Contact the leasing office for current availability.

title: George Moore Park - Fort Bliss Family Homes
description:
George Moore Park is a family housing neighborhood on Fort Bliss in El Paso, Texas, managed by Balfour Beatty Communities as part of Fort Bliss Family Homes. It is designed for junior enlisted Soldiers (E1-E6) and their families, with two- and three-bedroom homes that have one to two baths.

The neighborhood’s biggest draw is its location. It is within walking distance of Logan Elementary School, the George Underwood Golf Course, and several shops and restaurants, so many errands can be done without getting in the car.

Residents enjoy Fort Bliss Family Homes’ pet-friendly communities, with pools, playgrounds, park areas, and sport courts across post. George Moore Park is one of 17 Fort Bliss Family Homes neighborhoods. Call the leasing office for current floor plans and availability.

title: Nijmegen - Corvias at Fort Bragg
description:
Nijmegen is an on-post family housing neighborhood at Fort Bragg, North Carolina (called Fort Liberty from 2023 to 2025), managed by Corvias. The neighborhood offers three- and four-bedroom duplexes and townhomes with two to two-and-a-half baths, ranging from roughly 1,269 to 1,985 square feet depending on the floor plan.

All homes include washer and dryer hookups, and many have garages and outdoor storage. Select ADA-compliant homes are available. Nijmegen sits just off Longstreet Road with quick access to the 82nd Airborne Division area, and it is less than five minutes from the South Post Commissary and Exchange.

The Nijmegen Community Center has a fitness room for residents, and the neighborhood is near an elementary school and a dog park. Corvias also offers resort-style pools, basketball courts, playgrounds, and multimedia rooms across Fort Bragg. Contact Corvias for current availability and rank eligibility.

title: Tarawa Terrace II - Camp Lejeune Family Housing
description:
Tarawa Terrace II is a large family housing neighborhood just inside the Wilson Gate at Marine Corps Base Camp Lejeune, North Carolina, off Bougainville Drive. Named for the World War II Marine Corps battle in the Gilbert Islands, the neighborhood is managed by Hunt Military Communities and includes 778 two-, three-, and four-bedroom townhomes.

Floor plans include a three-bedroom, two-and-a-half-bath layout of about 1,618 square feet. Homes include screened patios, programmable thermostats, a dishwasher, garbage disposal, and microwave, walk-in closets and extra storage, air conditioning, and washer and dryer hookups. Select homes have fenced backyards or fireplaces.

Tarawa Terrace II is open to E1-E5 active-duty Marines and Sailors and may also be available to retirees and people who work on the installation. Residents benefit from professional landscaping, on-site management, 24-hour emergency maintenance, and nearby parks and playgrounds. Contact Camp Lejeune Family Housing for current availability.

title: Meriwether Landing - Liberty Military Housing
address: 5128 Pendleton Ave, Joint Base Lewis-McChord, WA 98433
description:
Meriwether Landing is one of the newest military housing communities at Joint Base Lewis-McChord, Washington. It opened on Lewis North in 2025 and is managed by Liberty Military Housing. The neighborhood has more than 200 new-construction duplex and single-family homes near American Lake and Meriwether Elementary School.

Floor plans are assigned by rank. For example, a two-story duplex for E5-E9 families has four bedrooms, two-and-a-half baths, and about 1,977 square feet, while officer and senior enlisted plans range up to about 2,500 square feet. Homes include attached two-car garages, fenced backyards, private patios, laundry rooms, air conditioning, pantries, walk-in closets, and modern flooring.

Residents are close to five parks with playgrounds and have access to community center amenities, Liberty’s Little Libraries, and free monthly resident events. The community is pet friendly, allowing up to four pets with some breed restrictions. Visit Liberty Military Housing’s website for current availability.

title: Gardner Hills - Campbell Crossing
description:
Gardner Hills is a family housing neighborhood in The Woodlands area of Fort Campbell, Kentucky, near Gate 1. It is part of Campbell Crossing, the Army’s privatized housing partnership on post, which has more than 4,000 homes across four communities. Different phases of Gardner Hills are designated for junior and senior noncommissioned officers.

A typical floor plan, The Lydia, offers three bedrooms and about 1,632 square feet, with a kitchen open to the dining room, a primary suite with a private bath, a one-car garage, and a fenced yard. Residents get complimentary front and side lawn service, free 24/7 on-site maintenance, and access to a Home and Garden Self Help Center.

Gardner Hills residents are served by The Commons at the Woodlands, with a meeting room and full kitchen, fitness room, splash park, walking trails, playgrounds, and tennis courts. Schools, a shoppette, and a coffee shop are nearby. Campbell Crossing is pet friendly (with breed restrictions) and is open to active duty, retirees, DoD civilians, and contractors. Contact the leasing office for availability.

title: SP Enlist - Naval Station Norfolk
description:
SP Enlist is an on-base military housing community at Naval Station Norfolk, Virginia, managed by Liberty Military Housing. Living inside the gates puts you close to the piers, the commissary, and the exchange at the world’s largest naval station.

The community offers four-bedroom, two-and-a-half-bath townhomes of about 1,405 square feet. Homes feature a fully equipped kitchen with stainless-steel appliances, a detached one-car garage, a fenced rear yard, air conditioning, and carpet throughout.

Residents enjoy on-base gated entry, a playground, basketball courts, and Liberty’s Little Libraries. Liberty manages more than 1,600 homes across ten communities in the Norfolk and Hampton Roads area and does not require credit checks or deposits for active-duty members. Contact Liberty Military Housing for current availability.

title: Stuart Mesa - Liberty Military Housing
description:
Stuart Mesa is a military family housing community at Marine Corps Base Camp Pendleton in Oceanside, California, managed by Liberty Military Housing. It sits near Del Mar Beach and is close to the Marine Corps Exchange and Carlsbad Premium Outlets, with restaurants and shops within walking distance.

The community offers two- to five-bedroom townhomes ranging from about 1,251 to 1,971 square feet, such as a three-bedroom, two-and-a-half-bath plan of about 1,377 square feet. Features include private patios, vaulted ceilings, walk-in closets, ceiling fans, and washer and dryer hookups, and garages are available.

Stuart Mesa has some of the best amenities on base: a community pool, fitness center, three dog parks, 20 playgrounds and tot lots, nine basketball courts, a soccer field, BBQ and picnic areas, plus free community events and 24/7 maintenance. Contact Liberty Military Housing for current availability and eligibility.

title: Dakota Ridge - Fort Carson Family Homes
description:
Dakota Ridge is a family housing neighborhood at Fort Carson, Colorado, just south of Colorado Springs, managed by Balfour Beatty Communities as part of Fort Carson Family Homes. The neighborhood offers four-bedroom homes for noncommissioned officers in the ranks of E5-E6.

Homes feature open floor plans, fully equipped kitchens, garages, patios, and fenced backyards, along with ceiling fans, central air, and washer and dryer hookups. With Pikes Peak views and easy access to the outdoors, it is a great fit for active families.

Dakota Ridge is near Patriot Elementary School, Carson Middle School, and Cheyenne Shadows Golf Club. Fort Carson Family Homes neighborhoods include playgrounds, athletic courts, trails, and community gardens, and they are pet friendly. Contact the leasing office for current availability.

title: McGraw Village - Heritage Landing at Fort Benning
description:
McGraw Village is a family housing neighborhood at Fort Benning, Georgia (called Fort Moore from 2023 to 2025), managed by The Michaels Organization as part of Heritage Landing. The neighborhood offers single-family homes and duplexes for senior noncommissioned officers in the ranks of E6-E8.

Homes feature two-car garages and backyards on sidewalk-lined streets. A popular floor plan, the Mourning Dove, offers three bedrooms, two-and-a-half baths, and about 1,720 square feet. Accessible floor plans are also available.

McGraw Village is steps from McBride Elementary School and the child development center. The village center has a large pool, splash ground, and community center, and there is a dog park for four-legged family members. Heritage Landing has two- to five-bedroom homes across Fort Benning, so contact the Family Housing Welcome Center for current availability.
